story_title: Lina and Adams Count at the Beach
title: Lina and Adams Count at the Beach 🔢 | Learn Numbers 1 to 6 in English for Kids | Moon Tales Kids
description:
Count boats, birds and stars with Lina, Adams and Milo on an evening at the beach! 🔢⛵🌟
In this English story for kids, children learn 7 new words: count, one, two, three, four, five and six. Listen, repeat, and count in English with Lina, Adams and Milo the cat.

📚 New words in this story:
🔢 count — يعد / العد — compter
1️⃣ one — واحد — un
2️⃣ two — اثنان — deux
3️⃣ three — ثلاثة — trois
4️⃣ four — أربعة — quatre
5️⃣ five — خمسة — cinq
6️⃣ six — ستة — six

👨‍👩‍👧 For parents: count things at home with your child — spoons, shoes, toys. Pause after each number and say it out loud with your fingers. Perfect for ages 3 to 8 and for children learning English as a second language.

🇲🇦 قصة باللغة الإنجليزية للأطفال لتعلم الأرقام من واحد إلى ستة.
🇫🇷 Une histoire en anglais pour enfants pour apprendre à compter de un à six.

lines.text: It is the evening. The sun is going down over the sea.
Lina, Adams and Milo the cat take a walk on the beach.
The sand is soft and warm.
Listen to the sea. Swish, swish!
Meow!
Lina has a fun idea for a game.
Adams, let's play a counting game!
A counting game? What is count?
When we count, we say numbers, one by one.
Let's count things we see on the beach!
When we say numbers in order, we count.
Say it with me: count!
Yes! I love to count!
Look at the water. What can you see?
I see a boat! One boat on the sea.
One! Let's hold up one finger.
One is the very first number. Hold up one finger, like Lina.
Can you say it? One!
The little boat rocks on the waves. Milo watches it. Meow!
Up in the sky, something is flying.
Look, birds! One, two. Two birds!
Two birds are flying home to sleep.
Two is one and one more. Hold up two fingers.
Let's say it together: two!
Milo looks up at the two birds. Meow, meow!
Adams finds some balls next to the sand.
One, two, three. Three balls!
Let's each take one ball. One for you, one for me, and one for Milo!
Three is two and one more. Hold up three fingers.
Say it with me: three!
Milo pushes his ball with his paw. Roll, roll!
Lina and Adams take off their shoes to walk on the sand.
I have two shoes. You have two shoes.
Let's count them all. One, two, three, four. Four shoes!
Four is three and one more. Hold up four fingers.
Can you say it? Four!
Wait. Where is Milo?
Milo is not there! Lina and Adams look around.
Don't worry, Adams. We will look together.
Let's count our friends. One, Lina. Two, Adams. And three should be Milo!
They walk slowly by the sea. They look and they listen.
Meow! The sound comes from the little boat on the sand.
There he is! Milo is sitting in the boat!
Hooray! Now we are three again!
Now it is night. The friends are home in the garden.
Look at the sky. The stars are shining!
Let's count the big stars. One, two, three, four, five!
Five is four and one more. Hold up one whole hand. Five fingers!
Say it with me: five!
Milo looks up at the sky with his big eyes.
Wait! I see one more star over there!
One, two, three, four, five, six. Six stars!
Six is five and one more. Hold up one hand and one more finger.
Let's say it together: six!
Six stars for six wishes!
My wish is to play the counting game again tomorrow!
Inside the house, it is time for a little snack.
Lina puts some apples on the plate.
Let's count the apples. Can you count with us?
One, two, three, four, five, six! Six apples!
Lina and Adams share the apples. Crunch, crunch!
Milo drinks some milk from his bowl. Lap, lap!
Thank you, Lina. Counting is so much fun!
Now Lina and Adams are in bed. Milo is sleepy too.
Today we counted one boat, two birds and three balls!
And four shoes, five stars, and then six stars!
Let's count one last time, very softly. One, two, three, four, five, six.
Outside the window, the moon smiles at them.
Good night, Milo.
Good night, everyone!
